summary.text: Lupe Diaz is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 19, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: In the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Diaz says Diaz was born in Cochise County, grew up in Bisbee as the son of a miner, and lives in Benson.

The profile says Diaz worked at Fort Huachuca, became a full-time pastor, received a call in 1988 to pastor a rural church in Benson, and is lead pastor of Grace Chapel Benson and administrator of Grace Christian Academy.
It also says Diaz served four years as president of the Benson/San Pedro Valley Chamber of Commerce and four years as a city councilman.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 19 (candidate-submitted statements)
